description: Prebuilt law library for Canon: the Internal Revenue Code (26 U.S.C., through Public Law 119-73), the Treasury regulations (26 CFR Parts 1 and 301, eCFR as of 2025-12-31) and California's Revenue and Taxation Code (Division 2, Parts 10 and 10.2, Personal Income Tax, as of 2026-11-22). 8,009 section rows, 134,206 passages, FTS5 + embeddinggemma-2 768-dim embeddings, and each document's source files.
_notes: GitHub Release asset (law-v2 tag). Optional: nothing needs law.db until an agent or a person asks for the law. Embeddings are EmbeddingGemma 2 (ollama/embeddinggemma-2, stamped in ref_meta).
